notes.title: Nocturnal 2 - Extended Trailer
notes.notes: [p]Dear adventurers,[/p][p align="start"]After a wild ride in Seattle at the Mix Showcase and at Gamescom, where we presented an extended demo of [i]Nocturnal 2[/i], we've recently unveiled a new trailer that showcases a bit more of what you can expect from this sequel.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We've received many questions about the game length and a demo. We can confirm that a demo will come a bit later and that yes, [i]Nocturnal 2[/i] is much longer and ambitious than its predecessor.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We'll get back to you with information regarding the demo and the release date soon![/p][p align="start"]In the meantime, please do not hesitate to wishlist [i]Nocturnal 2[/i], it really helps us.[/p][p align="start"]Cheers![/p][previewyoutube="pGBUATKm0no;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="1MxIrQ7VBVY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2847780/Nocturnal_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Nocturnal 2 first trailer!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to share the first trailer for Nocturnal 2!
This short preview focuses on the game's combat feel and showcases our new fire tech in action.

We've intentionally kept most content under wraps to preserve the best surprises for your own journey through the game, but we hope this glimpse sparks your curiosity!

Enjoy,
Cheers

notes.title: Nocturnal is now verified on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're happy to let you know that Nocturnal is now verified on Steam Deck! With all the micro improvements we made during these past few months, we hope that you'll enjoy the smoothest gameplay possible on the Deck.

Best,
The Sunnyside Team

notes.title: Nocturnal won the GOTY Award at the SWIGA 2023!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are absolutely thrilled to share that Nocturnal won the Best Game of the Year award at the Swiss Game Awards 2023!

By the way, we've received a lot of positive feedback about the recent release of the Enhanced Edition, and we want to personally thank you all for all those comments and messages on Discord. As a small team, your support significantly motivates us to overcome the challenges ahead.

Making video games is insanely hard, and seeing all this positivity just fills us up with joy.

We wish you a very good day.

Best,
The Sunnyside Team

notes.title: Nocturnal is available now!
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

Nocturnal is available now on Steam! Head on over to the Steam store and buy the game with [u][b]a 10% discount! [/b][/u]

[h2]A few tips before you begin your adventure on the island of Nahran:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Earn as many ashes as possible by killing enemies or smashing things to improve your skills
[*] Use fire healing to survive
[*] If you can't get through an obstacle, try looking for another way. You might have missed something
[*] Ranged attack may be one of the useful tools during your journey
[*] Make good use of jump/dash/roll to avoid enemy skills
[/list]
[h2]Feedback and reviews[/h2]

We'd love to get your feedback, whether positive or negative, as it will help us improve the game.
To properly celebrate the launch, here's the final trailer:
